message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the safest way is to use the “Forgot password?” link on the login page. That will send a reset link to the email address associated with your account, allowing you to create a new password securely.  

Let me know if you’d like instructions on how to reset it or if there’s anything else I can help with!
